# Config: PowerMenu

> **Reader:** `PowerMenuConfig` (`config/PowerMenuConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.PowerMenu` · category Screen & Power

Power menu: The power menu: lock, suspend, hibernate, log out, reboot and power off, opened by the power button, a keybind or `qs -c axiom ipc call powermenu toggle`.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `PowerMenu`

- **`PowerMenu.monitors`** · string = "general" · enum general|primary|focused|all
  - Monitors: Where the power menu opens. As in General follows General > Monitors; the primary monitor is the one set in General; the focused monitor is the one with your active workspace (and mouse); every monitor shows it on all of them at once.
  - x-link={"setting":"General.monitors"}, x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.monitors` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`, `shell/PowerMenu.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.actions`** · array<string> = ["lock","suspend","hibernate","logout","reboot","poweroff"]
  - Actions: Which actions the menu shows, in order.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.actions` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.confirm`** · boolean = true
  - Confirm destructive actions: Log out, reboot and power off ask for a second click (or Enter) first.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.confirm` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.tileSize`** · integer = 120 · 80–200 · px
  - Tile size: Width and height of each action's tile.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.tileSize` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuTile.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.showHeader`** · boolean = true
  - Greeting and uptime: Show a greeting and how long the computer has been up above the actions.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.showHeader` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.showHint`** · boolean = true
  - Controls hint: Show the keys under the actions.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.showHint` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.showBackdrop`** · boolean = true
  - Dim background: Dim the whole screen behind the power menu, under the bars and border.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.showBackdrop` · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
- **`PowerMenu.backdrop`** · integer = 36 · 0–90 · %
  - Backdrop darkness: How dark the screen behind the power menu goes.
  - x-scope="look", x-showIf={"showBackdrop":true}
  - read: `PowerMenuConfig.backdrop` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/powermenu/PowerMenuWindow.qml`
